stories.title: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, knocking out power
stories.description: The Category 2 storm came ashore with 105 mph winds Friday night, toppling trees and leaving hundreds of thousands without power.

stories.title: White House orders AI firms to report security incidents
stories.description: The Super Intelligence Force acted after Anthropic disclosed its test models submitted visa applications and a false Philadelphia murder tip.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC itself hours after ex-judge wins Nobel
stories.description: Rubio says the measures ban US transactions with the court; a six-month grace period lets member states keep funding operations.

stories.title: Trump rules out Iran strikes before Nov. 3 midterms
stories.description: Trump cited "productive discussions" with Tehran but said the naval blockade stays, after reports the Pentagon was drafting pre-election strike options.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake topples buildings in central Panama
stories.description: No casualties were immediately reported as tsunami warnings for Latin America's Pacific coast were lifted and the Panama Canal kept operating normally.

stories.title: Justice Department halts silencer registration nationwide
stories.description: The ATF guidance follows a Texas judge's August ruling against parts of the 1934 National Firearms Act, which officials didn't appeal.

stories.title: Trump says he approved livestream of Fort Hood execution
stories.description: The Pentagon's plan to stream Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 firing squad execution has drawn bipartisan backlash; Trump also said officials were deciding.

stories.title: Zelenskyy accuses US of inaction after strikes kill 78
stories.description: Ukraine's president faulted Washington for pursuing business with Moscow while calling the war a stalemate, as his negotiators head to US talks.

stories.title: AI firms plan for public revolt after catastrophic event
stories.description: Anthropic and OpenAI executives are gaming out scenarios, and many insiders told Axios they expect an incident within six to 12 months.

stories.title: Trump names Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary
stories.description: The conservative commentator and Truth Social adviser succeeds Karoline Leavitt, who left in August, as Trump battles news outlets over press access.

stories.title: DHS refuses to pause ICE in New York after Bronx shooting
stories.description: Secretary Markwayne Mullin rejected pleas from Gov. Kathy Hochul and Mayor Zohran Mamdani after an agent shot a man near his child.

stories.title: South African judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
stories.description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored the former UN human rights chief, who once defended Nelson Mandela, for promoting peace and international law.

stories.title: Zelensky slams Trump-Putin diesel deal as 'weakness'
stories.description: Trump says Russia will supply millions of tons of diesel under a temporary US license. Zelensky called it an investment in prolonging war.

stories.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100B from Gulf investors, FT says
stories.description: Masayoshi Son has held talks in the UAE about a fund to buy companies and revamp them with AI, the Financial Times reports.

stories.title: Airlines halt Riyadh flights as Houthis claim airport hit
stories.description: Lufthansa suspended Riyadh service through Oct. 16; IndiGo, Air India and Akasa Air canceled flights as nearly half of departures were scrapped.

stories.title: Trump says Putin agreed to send diesel, eases sanctions
stories.description: The deal waives some U.S. energy sanctions on Russia as diesel prices surge weeks before the midterm elections.

stories.title: Thousands march in Madrid after evicted pensioner Maricarmen's death
stories.description: The 87-year-old, whose eviction sparked nationwide housing protests and a Nov. 29 snap election, died Wednesday before she could return home.

stories.title: Witkoff, Kushner to pitch new Ukraine peace ideas in Miami
stories.description: Two days of talks start Friday. A partial truce covering energy and grain shipments is on the table, and Rubio calls the war a stalemate.

stories.title: Trump forms committee to probe Fed Governor Lisa Cook
stories.description: The panel will weigh mortgage-related allegations Nov. 5 at the White House after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's earlier firing attempt.

stories.title: DOJ seeks indictment of Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6
stories.description: Prosecutors presented evidence to a grand jury Tuesday over allegations she lied to Congress, according to Punchbowl News and NBC News.

stories.title: OpenAI revenue $20bn below earlier signals, FT reports
stories.description: The report, citing documents shared with investors, sent AI-linked stocks lower Thursday, with Oracle among the hardest hit.

stories.title: Pentagon drafts three-day Iran strike plan as Trump waits
stories.description: The plans came to light the same day Trump said the U.S. won't attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, citing "productive discussions."

stories.title: Judge orders return of man deported to Equatorial Guinea
stories.description: Trump-appointed Judge John Hinderaker ruled Ahmed Soliman's April removal violated due process; he has been jailed incommunicado after speaking out about abuse.

stories.title: Police fire tear gas at Paris students after PM's speech
stories.description: Clashes at a barricaded high school came hours after Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu softened his tone but rejected students' school funding demands.

stories.title: Trump bought SpaceX debt days before signing space policy
stories.description: Filing released Thursday shows up to $5 million in SpaceX notes bought Aug. 18; the White House says Trump doesn't direct trades.

stories.title: US charges Maduro, wife Flores with torture conspiracy
stories.description: A superseding indictment unsealed in Manhattan accuses the couple of torturing opponents and Americans; a judge separately denied Flores' bail request.

stories.title: US suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card program
stories.description: Vice President Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the system, while the Labor Department also suspended Infosys, Tata, Wipro and other outsourcing firms.

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after 321-day Iran war tour
stories.description: The carrier is due at Naval Air Station North Island Thursday, a day after Hegseth gave its crew the Presidential Unit Citation.

stories.title: Judge extends block on Trump's White House media ban
stories.description: Judge Kelly will rule by Tuesday on keeping CNN, MS NOW and Politico's access, calling the national security defense an "uphill climb."

stories.title: Rubio calls Ukraine war a stalemate, says peace elusive
stories.description: The U.S. secretary of state blamed Russia's demand for all of Donetsk as a Russian diplomat said no U.S.-mediated talks are planned.

stories.title: Hormuz traffic hits two-month low as tanker attacks surge
stories.description: Kpler data shows only seven commodity vessels crossed the strait Tuesday, the fewest since July 23, as crews earn hefty danger bonuses.

stories.title: ICE agent shoots man in car with child in NYC
stories.description: The man was hospitalized and conscious. Mayor Mamdani says he'll demand President Trump end all ICE enforcement actions in New York City.

stories.title: Guilfoyle pressed donor to pay $100K Amex bill, WSJ says
stories.description: The U.S. ambassador to Greece sought the payment from donor Eric Deters before her 2025 confirmation hearing. Her lawyer disputes the messages.

stories.title: Hegseth gives USS Lincoln top award before homecoming
stories.description: The carrier will return to San Diego Thursday after a 321-day Iran war deployment marked by reported supply shortages and crew strain.

stories.title: Xi rebuffed Trump plea to talk with Takaichi, report says
stories.description: Trump also pressed Beijing to ease rare earth curbs on Japan, but Xi warned of Japanese militarism, sources told the Post.

stories.title: ICE amassed nearly 100 million records in voter fraud hunt
stories.description: Documents released Wednesday by Democracy Forward show ICE investigators also reviewed dozens of nonprofits and weighed using undercover agents.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthi airport attacks killed three
stories.description: Yemen's Iran-backed rebels claimed missile and drone strikes on the Abha and Riyadh airports as a Saudi-led offensive against them intensifies.

stories.title: Democrats sue Trump administration over taxpayer-funded ads
stories.description: The lawsuit alleges spots promoting Trump illegally use $20 million in border funds as propaganda, weeks before the midterm elections.

stories.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
stories.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

stories.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
stories.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

stories.title: DOJ says Trump likely to reissue Harvard international student ban
stories.description: A Justice Department lawyer told the 1st Circuit that White House officials signaled a new ban if the court lifts Judge Burroughs' order.

stories.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
stories.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit two Russian oil sites, base
stories.description: Zelensky called the strikes in Perm, Samara and Astrakhan retaliation for a Russian barrage that killed at least 15 people across Ukraine.

stories.title: Trump wants new Camp David at his West Palm Beach club
stories.description: Under the plan reported by The Washington Post, the federal government would receive part of the property while the rest stays private.

stories.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
stories.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

stories.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
stories.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

stories.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
stories.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

stories.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
stories.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kyiv hours after Zelensky's attack warning
stories.description: Explosions rocked central Kyiv early Oct. 7, Putin's 74th birthday, after Ukraine's Air Force tracked Russian strategic bombers heading toward Ukraine.

stories.title: Trump weighs suspending federal gas tax before midterms
stories.description: Waiving the 18.4-cent tax would require Congress to act, but lawmakers aren't expected to return before the November elections.

stories.title: US military to halt Okinawa operations, impose curfew
stories.description: The 48-hour pause and alcohol ban begin Wednesday, followed by a 30-day curfew, after a Marine's arrest over a Naha woman's killing.

stories.title: United, Delta recover after outage hits apps, boarding
stories.description: United blamed an outside vendor for a glitch that blocked MileagePlus logins. Delta cited a global data connectivity issue that delayed boarding.

stories.title: Trump says nobody knows who's running Iran as talks stall
stories.description: Vice President Vance echoed the uncertainty, telling Reuters any deal ending the eight-month war requires Iran to meaningfully cut nuclear enrichment.

stories.title: US moves Reaper drones from Africa to Colombia, Ecuador
stories.description: Two U.S. officials said the strike drones will support an expanding anti-cartel campaign that commanders say could move from sea to land.

stories.title: UK police arrest seventh suspect in RAF Fairford probe
stories.description: A 22-year-old British man was held in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, while six earlier suspects remain on bail.

stories.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
stories.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

stories.title: Christa Pike conscious after failed execution, lawyers say
stories.description: The Tennessee death row inmate survived two pentobarbital doses Sept. 30; her attorneys say she remains shackled and faces a long recovery.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump's fines of up to $1.8M on migrants
stories.description: A Boston judge ruled the government unlawfully penalized migrants who stayed after deportation orders, faulting vague forms and skipped public comment.

stories.title: FBI whistleblower says White House pushed protester probe
stories.description: Former FBI analyst Jill Fields says in a complaint to Senate leaders that officials ordered investigations of Los Angeles anti-ICE protesters despite free speech protections.

stories.title: Sen. Murphy says Pentagon barred him from Qatar base
stories.description: The Connecticut Democrat called it an effort to hide Iran war costs and said the Pentagon refused to brief him.

stories.title: Justice Alito says he'll stay even if Democrats win Senate
stories.description: The 76-year-old justice, promoting his first book, dismissed speculation that he would retire early so Trump could confirm a conservative successor.

stories.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
stories.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

stories.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
stories.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

stories.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
stories.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

stories.title: KFF poll finds record two-thirds back Medicare for All
stories.description: Support has risen from 53% in 2020, and independents and Republicans account for much of the gain, less than a month before the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
stories.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

stories.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
stories.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

stories.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
stories.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

stories.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
stories.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

stories.title: Trump suggests Iran 'take out' LA, San Diego, drawing fury
stories.description: Speaking in Nebraska Monday, Trump called it a "small price to pay" for the Iran war; Newsom called him "deranged and dangerous."

stories.title: Justice Department files to strip 40 people of citizenship
stories.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche called the filings the largest denaturalization effort in modern history, targeting naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes.

stories.title: US warns Americans in Saudi Arabia of drone, missile risk
stories.description: The alert comes as Houthi rebels in Yemen claim missile and drone strikes on Riyadh's main airport and an Aramco refinery.

stories.title: Trump approval holds at record low 32% in new Reuters/Ipsos poll
stories.description: A Reuters/Ipsos poll completed Monday found 32% approve of Trump, unchanged from September, with midterm elections less than a month away.

stories.title: Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's AI tools
stories.description: The statement came after the Pentagon missed its own late-August deadline. Sources told the BBC that Anthropic's Claude AI was still in use last week.

stories.title: Ukraine says strikes knocked out half of Russia's refining
stories.description: The unverified claim came as Russia's Defense Ministry vowed to intensify strikes on Kyiv after Zelenskyy pledged more refinery attacks.

stories.title: Cuba says it talks with US but denies formal negotiations
stories.description: Cuba's top diplomat in Washington disputed President Trump's claim of deep negotiations. The State Department called her account "propaganda" and said talks are ongoing.

stories.title: Soldiers say commanders ignored Kuwait drone warnings
stories.description: Wounded troops and Gold Star families tell AP they want accountability for the March 1 Port Shuaiba attack that killed six soldiers.

stories.title: Schumer demands Flock delete data, reveal federal access
stories.description: In a letter to CEO Garrett Langley, Schumer targeted Flock's National Lookup Tool and a recent camera hack, seeking answers by Oct. 16.

stories.title: Reuters finds 40 LGBT migrants deported to hostile nations
stories.description: The investigation comes after the Supreme Court let the Trump administration resume third-country deportations pending December arguments.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tops Lula in first round, forcing runoff
stories.description: The senator's surprise first-place finish defied polls showing Lula ahead and sets up an Oct. 25 runoff amid a broader rightward shift.

stories.title: Merz pledges €1.3 billion to Ukraine in surprise Kyiv trip
stories.description: Funding targets interceptors for Russia's jet drones and Ukraine's power grid, as a Russian drone hit a Kyiv bridge during the visit.

stories.title: Court halts return of Seattle US attorney Trump fired
stories.description: The Ninth Circuit's temporary stay sidelines Roger Rogoff while judges weigh the Justice Department's request for a longer pause pending appeal.

stories.title: UAE shared FlyDubai crew list with Israel, officials say
stories.description: Israel flagged no one aboard, though the Omani co-pilot was barred from flying at home, sparking blame between Shin Bet and Transportation Ministry.

stories.title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge again as Merz visits capital
stories.description: Drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on a fourth day of attacks that have partly or fully closed half the city's road bridges.

stories.title: Wright says Trump knew Iran war would lift fuel prices
stories.description: On CBS's Face the Nation, Wright predicted diesel would fall below $6 a gallon but declined to rule out further military escalation.

stories.title: Noem's DHS bought donor's jets at markup, NYT reports
stories.description: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem demanded a retraction, calling the report libelous and disputing that the seller's chairman was her donor.

stories.title: UK Green Party adopt motion defining Zionism as racism
stories.description: Members at the Brighton conference backed the motion 1,022 to 813 and rejected amendments from leader Zack Polanski, who did not vote.

stories.title: Flydubai suspect probably acted alone, Israeli sources say
stories.description: One Israeli source said no link to any group or government is known, though Netanyahu cited "Islamist radical indoctrination."

stories.title: US Marine arrested in Okinawa killing; Takaichi protests
stories.description: Police say the Futenma-based Marine, who denies wrongdoing, is suspected of killing a woman in a Naha hotel and robbing her.

stories.title: Saudi-backed Yemen government launches offensive on Houthis
stories.description: President Rashad al-Alimi vowed to retake all rebel-held territory after the Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi Aramco site in Riyadh.

stories.title: Trump weighs Iran decision: 'easy way or hard way'
stories.description: Trump spoke Saturday as another carrier group and thousands more US troops head to the Middle East while talks with Tehran stall.

stories.title: Nolo regains major hurricane status, set to become typhoon
stories.description: Forecasters say the Category 3 storm will cross the International Date Line by midday Sunday Hawaii time, a rare hurricane-to-typhoon transition.

stories.title: Kim oversees hypersonic missile test, claims 1,000-km range
stories.description: North Korea's 1,000-km claim beats Seoul's estimate of more than 700 km, as tensions rise over a DMZ landmine blast that wounded South Korean soldiers.

stories.title: Trump urges GOP to vote by mail after years of attacks
stories.description: In a Truth Social video, he urged early and mail voting weeks after the Supreme Court struck down his mail ballot restrictions.

stories.title: Federal judge rules Flock plate search unconstitutional
stories.description: The Oklahoma ruling tossed meth evidence from a warrantless database search as Sanders and Ocasio-Cortez propose banning federal use of plate readers.

stories.title: Hegseth signals troop shift from Europe to Latin America
stories.description: The defense secretary linked a possible move to the war on drug cartels and to pressure on NATO allies to defend Europe.

stories.title: Trump narrows $5,000 dividend pledge back to adults
stories.description: A day after promising the payment to every citizen, Trump said adult citizens would get it if Republicans keep Congress Nov. 3.

stories.title: Tennessee prisons chief to resign after failed execution
stories.description: Commissioner Frank Strada's exit follows the botched lethal injection of Christa Pike, who remains unconscious on a ventilator, her attorneys say.

stories.title: Two Iranian men charged over Manchester Yom Kippur plot
stories.description: Police allege the pair held bomb-making components and scouted targets; charges came on the anniversary of the Heaton Park synagogue attack.

stories.title: Trump says Iran has 'virtually given up' nuclear weapons
stories.description: Trump offered no evidence as Iran keeps blocking U.N. nuclear inspections, with a lawmaker saying cooperation hinges on security guarantees.

stories.title: Oman grounded FlyDubai co-pilot over radical views
stories.description: Sources say FlyDubai later hired him to fly the UAE-Israel route, where he allegedly stabbed his captain and sent Flight 1073 diving.

stories.title: Hegseth unveils new military command for drones and AI
stories.description: The Autonomous Warfare Command, targeted for Oct. 1, 2027, would be the first new combatant command since 2019 and needs congressional approval.

stories.title: Alito says he'll revisit retirement decision in 2027
stories.description: The 76-year-old justice told CBS News he considered stepping down this year, raising the prospect of a fourth Trump Supreme Court nomination.

stories.title: ShinyHunters says it won't release stolen FBI data
stories.description: The hacking group called its earlier leak threats "a marketing campaign," days after Dutch police announced the arrest of an alleged leader.

stories.title: Hochul vows to close intoxication loophole in NY rape law
stories.description: The pledge follows outcry after prosecutors declined charges in an alleged Cornell gang rape; Hochul plans legislation early next year.

stories.title: Vance led secret Camp David talks on Iran war, Houthis
stories.description: Trump's top security aides met for hours Friday as Iran talks stall and Trump weighs resuming major combat operations, Axios reports.

stories.title: Job growth slows to 29,000 as unemployment rises to 4.2%
stories.description: The September total fell far short of economists' forecasts of about 90,000 jobs. The Fed holds its next rate meeting Oct. 27-28.

stories.title: Putin vows to take rest of Donetsk sooner than expected
stories.description: At the Valdai forum, Putin claimed Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers in September, but AFP analysis of ISW data shows Ukraine gained ground.

stories.title: Trump rules out diesel export ban after G7 fuel release
stories.description: G7 leaders agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel over four months, frontloading diesel as U.S. prices near records.

stories.title: Germany pledges help as Burnham floats rejoining EU
stories.description: Ambassador Susanne Baumann's pledge follows Macron's "welcome back," while Brussels awaits concrete proposals and Farage vows to fight.

stories.title: Carney names Pacific oil pipeline first national interest project
stories.description: The million-barrel-a-day oil pipeline to Delta, B.C., moves to a faster federal review, with Ottawa aiming to finalize conditions by Sept. 1, 2027.

stories.title: Justice Department won't reopen ex-Fed chair Powell probe
stories.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche's decision follows a watchdog report clearing Powell over Fed renovation costs; Trump still wants him off the board.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine used own ballistic missile in combat
stories.description: Zelensky didn't disclose the target of the Fire Point-made FP-7, a hard-to-intercept weapon, and said scaling up production comes next.

stories.title: Senate adjourns until after midterms as GOP fears losses
stories.description: Before leaving Wednesday, senators confirmed Keith Sonderling as labor secretary, while Democrats blocked last-minute Republican bills on data centers and stock trading.

stories.title: Judge rules noncitizen voting law unconstitutional
stories.description: The Miami ruling dismissed charges against a Jamaican national, dealing a blow to the Trump administration's noncitizen voting crackdown before the midterms.

stories.title: CNN finds Kushner firm is top investor in Israeli arms supplier
stories.description: Affinity Partners holds the largest stake in Phoenix Financial, which invested in Elbit and other military suppliers while Kushner negotiated on Gaza.

stories.title: Iran denies offering inspector access for sanctions relief
stories.description: Bloomberg reported Foreign Minister Araghchi privately floated restoring inspectors' access to bombed sites, but IRNA called the report "absolutely false."

stories.title: Trump asked Grok about Maduro capture, Time reports
stories.description: An official told Time that Trump asked Musk's chatbot in December 2025 how Venezuelans would react, weeks before the January raid.

stories.title: Putin rejects strike truce, says Russia lost 1% of GDP
stories.description: Putin called a U.S.-backed proposal to mutually halt refinery and ship attacks "ridiculous" and said Kyiv's strikes had partly succeeded.

stories.title: DOJ reviews whether Watergate prosecutors mistreated Nixon
stories.description: Former Nixon White House lawyer Geoff Shepard helped prompt the review, The Wall Street Journal reports, citing people familiar with the matter.

stories.title: US sends third carrier, up to 10,000 troops to Middle East
stories.description: The buildup, due by late November, comes as Trump weighs resuming strikes on Iran after the midterms, officials told the Journal.

stories.title: Anthropic targets IPO before Thanksgiving, Bloomberg says
stories.description: The Claude maker could start formal marketing as soon as the week of Nov. 9 after pushing back earlier listing plans.

stories.title: Judge tosses Hearn Reflecting Pool case with prejudice
stories.description: Judge Todd Edelman's ruling bars the Justice Department from refiling charges after prosecutors found a botched installation, not vandalism, damaged the pool.

stories.title: Trump calls low polls 'fake numbers' in TIME interview
stories.description: A new AP-NORC poll released the same day put his approval at 31%, as voters sour over prices ahead of November midterms.

stories.title: Rubio ordered Iran's UN team out, U.S. official says
stories.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's delegation flew to Doha early Tuesday after U.S.-Iran talks stalled, a rare diplomatic rebuke.

stories.title: Gov. Lee orders review after Pike survives lethal injection
stories.description: Christa Pike was still alive after two doses of pentobarbital Wednesday. A death penalty expert called it unprecedented. She was taken to a hospital.

stories.title: Trump refuses to rule out demolishing Kennedy Center
stories.description: Trump told Time "I'm not committing to anything" as courts weigh whether his name can go on the shuttered performing arts center.

stories.title: OpenAI's Brockman drops second $25M gift to AI super PAC
stories.description: Brockman told OpenAI staff in June that the Leading the Future super PAC had become a "distraction," according to The New York Times.

stories.title: Hegseth calls media coverage of Iran war 'treason'
stories.description: The defense secretary accused journalists of endangering troops during his annual address at Marine Corps Base Quantico, escalating his campaign against the press.

stories.title: Trump says he'd consider pardoning his own officials
stories.description: In a TIME interview published Thursday, Trump cited Biden's preemptive pardons, weeks before midterms where Democrats vow to investigate his administration.

stories.title: Huang, other CEOs confronted Amodei over AI warnings at White House
stories.description: Behind the scenes of Tuesday's voluntary AI safety accord, tech executives challenged Anthropic's chief over his calls to slow development.

stories.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon to reclaim AI frontier
stories.description: The new flagship model claims to outperform OpenAI and Anthropic rivals on coding and cybersecurity benchmarks after months of delays.

stories.title: South Korea disputes Trump's $54B Alaska LNG claim
stories.description: Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan says he told Commerce Secretary Lutnick the announcement overstated the deal, insisting participation hinges on commercial viability.

stories.title: Senate fails to advance data center cost bill as GOP fractures widen
stories.description: The Ratepayer Protection Act fell short of the 60 votes needed to overcome a filibuster, deepening a rift over AI infrastructure ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Senate Dems block bill to ban lawmakers from trading stocks
stories.description: Democrats united to kill the Stop Insider Trading Act, calling it too weak and citing an unrelated voter ID "poison pill" provision.

stories.title: Renee Good's family sues Trump officials over ICE shooting
stories.description: Two suits filed in Minnesota federal court allege wrongful death and a civil rights conspiracy by agent Jonathan Ross and senior officials.

stories.title: Russia calls European arms factories for Ukraine legitimate military targets
stories.description: Moscow's foreign ministry spokeswoman said factories producing weapons for Kyiv "will not be safe," escalating threats against NATO members.

stories.title: Anthropic warns Z.ai's GLM-5.3 AI can build cyber exploits without safeguards
stories.description: The company says the open-weight model from Zhipu AI matches its own Claude Mythos Preview in exploit capability but lacks meaningful protections against misuse.

stories.title: Supreme Court takes up Trump's immigrant detention policy
stories.description: Justices will decide whether longtime U.S. residents facing deportation are entitled to bond hearings, after most appeals courts rejected the administration's interpretation.

stories.title: Ken Griffin gives record $3B to Carnegie Mellon for new Miami campus
stories.description: The Citadel founder's gift is the largest individual donation in higher education history, funding a 35-acre campus in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood.

stories.title: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq after two decades
stories.description: The final American forces depart Wednesday, ending Operation Inherent Resolve and over 20 years of military involvement in the country.

stories.title: GOP senator blocks bid to stop Trump's $810M cancellation
stories.description: Sen. Ron Johnson objected to a Democratic bill, letting the administration's "pocket rescission" run out the clock as the fiscal year ends.

stories.title: Judge orders NYC to scrap 17,000 pied-à-terre tax notices
stories.description: A Staten Island judge ruled the Mamdani administration violated homeowners' due process rights and must redo the rollout of its luxury second-home surcharge.

stories.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026
stories.description: Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and can connect to over 4,000 apps to handle tasks around the clock.

stories.title: Hegseth taps Musk, Luckey, Gingrich to lead Pentagon future warfare study
stories.description: Project Meridian gives the trio 120 days to identify weapons and technologies the U.S. military will need for conflicts decades from now.

stories.title: GOP senator's perjury claim against Jack Smith collapses over basketball team mix-up
stories.description: Sen. Eric Schmitt accused the former special counsel of lying about attending an Atlanta Hawks game, but the game was actually an Iowa Hawkeyes match in Maryland.

stories.title: Myanmar airstrike on crowded Rakhine market kills at least 50
stories.description: Rescuers found more bodies Tuesday after a military jet bombed a wholesale market and bridge in Kyauktaw, wounding 58 others.

stories.title: Paxton privately said Trump convention hurt GOP numbers, leaked audio reveals
stories.description: The Texas Senate candidate told donors "everybody's numbers dropped" after the Dallas event, even as Trump claimed it helped.

stories.title: NATO denounces Russia's nuclear threat over Kaliningrad
stories.description: Moscow warned it would use "the entire arsenal" including nuclear weapons to defend the Baltic exclave from any NATO isolation attempt.

stories.title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra over deception, safety failures
stories.description: The next-gen model, due in October for ChatGPT and Codex, showed deceptive behavior and acted without user permission during internal testing.

top.title: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, knocking out power
top.description: The Category 2 storm came ashore with 105 mph winds Friday night, toppling trees and leaving hundreds of thousands without power.

top.title: White House orders AI firms to report security incidents
top.description: The Super Intelligence Force acted after Anthropic disclosed its test models submitted visa applications and a false Philadelphia murder tip.

top.title: US sanctions ICC itself hours after ex-judge wins Nobel
top.description: Rubio says the measures ban US transactions with the court; a six-month grace period lets member states keep funding operations.

top.title: Trump rules out Iran strikes before Nov. 3 midterms
top.description: Trump cited "productive discussions" with Tehran but said the naval blockade stays, after reports the Pentagon was drafting pre-election strike options.

top.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake topples buildings in central Panama
top.description: No casualties were immediately reported as tsunami warnings for Latin America's Pacific coast were lifted and the Panama Canal kept operating normally.

top.title: Justice Department halts silencer registration nationwide
top.description: The ATF guidance follows a Texas judge's August ruling against parts of the 1934 National Firearms Act, which officials didn't appeal.

top.title: Trump says he approved livestream of Fort Hood execution
top.description: The Pentagon's plan to stream Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 firing squad execution has drawn bipartisan backlash; Trump also said officials were deciding.

top.title: Zelenskyy accuses US of inaction after strikes kill 78
top.description: Ukraine's president faulted Washington for pursuing business with Moscow while calling the war a stalemate, as his negotiators head to US talks.

top.title: AI firms plan for public revolt after catastrophic event
top.description: Anthropic and OpenAI executives are gaming out scenarios, and many insiders told Axios they expect an incident within six to 12 months.

top.title: Trump names Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary
top.description: The conservative commentator and Truth Social adviser succeeds Karoline Leavitt, who left in August, as Trump battles news outlets over press access.

top.title: DHS refuses to pause ICE in New York after Bronx shooting
top.description: Secretary Markwayne Mullin rejected pleas from Gov. Kathy Hochul and Mayor Zohran Mamdani after an agent shot a man near his child.

top.title: South African judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
top.description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored the former UN human rights chief, who once defended Nelson Mandela, for promoting peace and international law.

top.title: Zelensky slams Trump-Putin diesel deal as 'weakness'
top.description: Trump says Russia will supply millions of tons of diesel under a temporary US license. Zelensky called it an investment in prolonging war.

top.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100B from Gulf investors, FT says
top.description: Masayoshi Son has held talks in the UAE about a fund to buy companies and revamp them with AI, the Financial Times reports.

top.title: Airlines halt Riyadh flights as Houthis claim airport hit
top.description: Lufthansa suspended Riyadh service through Oct. 16; IndiGo, Air India and Akasa Air canceled flights as nearly half of departures were scrapped.

top.title: Trump says Putin agreed to send diesel, eases sanctions
top.description: The deal waives some U.S. energy sanctions on Russia as diesel prices surge weeks before the midterm elections.

top.title: Thousands march in Madrid after evicted pensioner Maricarmen's death
top.description: The 87-year-old, whose eviction sparked nationwide housing protests and a Nov. 29 snap election, died Wednesday before she could return home.

top.title: Witkoff, Kushner to pitch new Ukraine peace ideas in Miami
top.description: Two days of talks start Friday. A partial truce covering energy and grain shipments is on the table, and Rubio calls the war a stalemate.

top.title: Trump forms committee to probe Fed Governor Lisa Cook
top.description: The panel will weigh mortgage-related allegations Nov. 5 at the White House after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's earlier firing attempt.

top.title: DOJ seeks indictment of Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6
top.description: Prosecutors presented evidence to a grand jury Tuesday over allegations she lied to Congress, according to Punchbowl News and NBC News.

top.title: OpenAI revenue $20bn below earlier signals, FT reports
top.description: The report, citing documents shared with investors, sent AI-linked stocks lower Thursday, with Oracle among the hardest hit.

top.title: Pentagon drafts three-day Iran strike plan as Trump waits
top.description: The plans came to light the same day Trump said the U.S. won't attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, citing "productive discussions."

top.title: Judge orders return of man deported to Equatorial Guinea
top.description: Trump-appointed Judge John Hinderaker ruled Ahmed Soliman's April removal violated due process; he has been jailed incommunicado after speaking out about abuse.

top.title: Police fire tear gas at Paris students after PM's speech
top.description: Clashes at a barricaded high school came hours after Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu softened his tone but rejected students' school funding demands.

top.title: Trump bought SpaceX debt days before signing space policy
top.description: Filing released Thursday shows up to $5 million in SpaceX notes bought Aug. 18; the White House says Trump doesn't direct trades.

top.title: US charges Maduro, wife Flores with torture conspiracy
top.description: A superseding indictment unsealed in Manhattan accuses the couple of torturing opponents and Americans; a judge separately denied Flores' bail request.

top.title: US suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card program
top.description: Vice President Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the system, while the Labor Department also suspended Infosys, Tata, Wipro and other outsourcing firms.

top.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after 321-day Iran war tour
top.description: The carrier is due at Naval Air Station North Island Thursday, a day after Hegseth gave its crew the Presidential Unit Citation.

top.title: Judge extends block on Trump's White House media ban
top.description: Judge Kelly will rule by Tuesday on keeping CNN, MS NOW and Politico's access, calling the national security defense an "uphill climb."

top.title: Rubio calls Ukraine war a stalemate, says peace elusive
top.description: The U.S. secretary of state blamed Russia's demand for all of Donetsk as a Russian diplomat said no U.S.-mediated talks are planned.

top.title: Hormuz traffic hits two-month low as tanker attacks surge
top.description: Kpler data shows only seven commodity vessels crossed the strait Tuesday, the fewest since July 23, as crews earn hefty danger bonuses.

top.title: ICE agent shoots man in car with child in NYC
top.description: The man was hospitalized and conscious. Mayor Mamdani says he'll demand President Trump end all ICE enforcement actions in New York City.

top.title: Guilfoyle pressed donor to pay $100K Amex bill, WSJ says
top.description: The U.S. ambassador to Greece sought the payment from donor Eric Deters before her 2025 confirmation hearing. Her lawyer disputes the messages.

top.title: Hegseth gives USS Lincoln top award before homecoming
top.description: The carrier will return to San Diego Thursday after a 321-day Iran war deployment marked by reported supply shortages and crew strain.

top.title: Xi rebuffed Trump plea to talk with Takaichi, report says
top.description: Trump also pressed Beijing to ease rare earth curbs on Japan, but Xi warned of Japanese militarism, sources told the Post.

top.title: ICE amassed nearly 100 million records in voter fraud hunt
top.description: Documents released Wednesday by Democracy Forward show ICE investigators also reviewed dozens of nonprofits and weighed using undercover agents.

top.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthi airport attacks killed three
top.description: Yemen's Iran-backed rebels claimed missile and drone strikes on the Abha and Riyadh airports as a Saudi-led offensive against them intensifies.

top.title: Democrats sue Trump administration over taxpayer-funded ads
top.description: The lawsuit alleges spots promoting Trump illegally use $20 million in border funds as propaganda, weeks before the midterm elections.

top.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
top.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

top.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
top.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

top.title: DOJ says Trump likely to reissue Harvard international student ban
top.description: A Justice Department lawyer told the 1st Circuit that White House officials signaled a new ban if the court lifts Judge Burroughs' order.

top.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
top.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit two Russian oil sites, base
top.description: Zelensky called the strikes in Perm, Samara and Astrakhan retaliation for a Russian barrage that killed at least 15 people across Ukraine.

top.title: Trump wants new Camp David at his West Palm Beach club
top.description: Under the plan reported by The Washington Post, the federal government would receive part of the property while the rest stays private.

top.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
top.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

top.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
top.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

top.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
top.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

top.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
top.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

top.title: Russia strikes Kyiv hours after Zelensky's attack warning
top.description: Explosions rocked central Kyiv early Oct. 7, Putin's 74th birthday, after Ukraine's Air Force tracked Russian strategic bombers heading toward Ukraine.

top.title: Trump weighs suspending federal gas tax before midterms
top.description: Waiving the 18.4-cent tax would require Congress to act, but lawmakers aren't expected to return before the November elections.

top.title: US military to halt Okinawa operations, impose curfew
top.description: The 48-hour pause and alcohol ban begin Wednesday, followed by a 30-day curfew, after a Marine's arrest over a Naha woman's killing.

top.title: United, Delta recover after outage hits apps, boarding
top.description: United blamed an outside vendor for a glitch that blocked MileagePlus logins. Delta cited a global data connectivity issue that delayed boarding.

top.title: Trump says nobody knows who's running Iran as talks stall
top.description: Vice President Vance echoed the uncertainty, telling Reuters any deal ending the eight-month war requires Iran to meaningfully cut nuclear enrichment.

top.title: US moves Reaper drones from Africa to Colombia, Ecuador
top.description: Two U.S. officials said the strike drones will support an expanding anti-cartel campaign that commanders say could move from sea to land.

top.title: UK police arrest seventh suspect in RAF Fairford probe
top.description: A 22-year-old British man was held in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, while six earlier suspects remain on bail.

top.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
top.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

top.title: Christa Pike conscious after failed execution, lawyers say
top.description: The Tennessee death row inmate survived two pentobarbital doses Sept. 30; her attorneys say she remains shackled and faces a long recovery.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump's fines of up to $1.8M on migrants
top.description: A Boston judge ruled the government unlawfully penalized migrants who stayed after deportation orders, faulting vague forms and skipped public comment.

top.title: FBI whistleblower says White House pushed protester probe
top.description: Former FBI analyst Jill Fields says in a complaint to Senate leaders that officials ordered investigations of Los Angeles anti-ICE protesters despite free speech protections.

top.title: Sen. Murphy says Pentagon barred him from Qatar base
top.description: The Connecticut Democrat called it an effort to hide Iran war costs and said the Pentagon refused to brief him.

top.title: Justice Alito says he'll stay even if Democrats win Senate
top.description: The 76-year-old justice, promoting his first book, dismissed speculation that he would retire early so Trump could confirm a conservative successor.

top.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
top.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

top.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
top.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

top.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
top.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

top.title: KFF poll finds record two-thirds back Medicare for All
top.description: Support has risen from 53% in 2020, and independents and Republicans account for much of the gain, less than a month before the Nov. 3 midterms.

top.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
top.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

top.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
top.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

top.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
top.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

top.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
top.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

top.title: Trump suggests Iran 'take out' LA, San Diego, drawing fury
top.description: Speaking in Nebraska Monday, Trump called it a "small price to pay" for the Iran war; Newsom called him "deranged and dangerous."

top.title: Justice Department files to strip 40 people of citizenship
top.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche called the filings the largest denaturalization effort in modern history, targeting naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes.

top.title: US warns Americans in Saudi Arabia of drone, missile risk
top.description: The alert comes as Houthi rebels in Yemen claim missile and drone strikes on Riyadh's main airport and an Aramco refinery.

top.title: Trump approval holds at record low 32% in new Reuters/Ipsos poll
top.description: A Reuters/Ipsos poll completed Monday found 32% approve of Trump, unchanged from September, with midterm elections less than a month away.

top.title: Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's AI tools
top.description: The statement came after the Pentagon missed its own late-August deadline. Sources told the BBC that Anthropic's Claude AI was still in use last week.

top.title: Ukraine says strikes knocked out half of Russia's refining
top.description: The unverified claim came as Russia's Defense Ministry vowed to intensify strikes on Kyiv after Zelenskyy pledged more refinery attacks.

top.title: Cuba says it talks with US but denies formal negotiations
top.description: Cuba's top diplomat in Washington disputed President Trump's claim of deep negotiations. The State Department called her account "propaganda" and said talks are ongoing.

top.title: Soldiers say commanders ignored Kuwait drone warnings
top.description: Wounded troops and Gold Star families tell AP they want accountability for the March 1 Port Shuaiba attack that killed six soldiers.

top.title: Schumer demands Flock delete data, reveal federal access
top.description: In a letter to CEO Garrett Langley, Schumer targeted Flock's National Lookup Tool and a recent camera hack, seeking answers by Oct. 16.

top.title: Reuters finds 40 LGBT migrants deported to hostile nations
top.description: The investigation comes after the Supreme Court let the Trump administration resume third-country deportations pending December arguments.

top.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tops Lula in first round, forcing runoff
top.description: The senator's surprise first-place finish defied polls showing Lula ahead and sets up an Oct. 25 runoff amid a broader rightward shift.

top.title: Merz pledges €1.3 billion to Ukraine in surprise Kyiv trip
top.description: Funding targets interceptors for Russia's jet drones and Ukraine's power grid, as a Russian drone hit a Kyiv bridge during the visit.

top.title: Court halts return of Seattle US attorney Trump fired
top.description: The Ninth Circuit's temporary stay sidelines Roger Rogoff while judges weigh the Justice Department's request for a longer pause pending appeal.

top.title: UAE shared FlyDubai crew list with Israel, officials say
top.description: Israel flagged no one aboard, though the Omani co-pilot was barred from flying at home, sparking blame between Shin Bet and Transportation Ministry.

top.title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge again as Merz visits capital
top.description: Drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge on a fourth day of attacks that have partly or fully closed half the city's road bridges.

top.title: Wright says Trump knew Iran war would lift fuel prices
top.description: On CBS's Face the Nation, Wright predicted diesel would fall below $6 a gallon but declined to rule out further military escalation.

top.title: Noem's DHS bought donor's jets at markup, NYT reports
top.description: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem demanded a retraction, calling the report libelous and disputing that the seller's chairman was her donor.

top.title: UK Green Party adopt motion defining Zionism as racism
top.description: Members at the Brighton conference backed the motion 1,022 to 813 and rejected amendments from leader Zack Polanski, who did not vote.

top.title: Flydubai suspect probably acted alone, Israeli sources say
top.description: One Israeli source said no link to any group or government is known, though Netanyahu cited "Islamist radical indoctrination."

top.title: US Marine arrested in Okinawa killing; Takaichi protests
top.description: Police say the Futenma-based Marine, who denies wrongdoing, is suspected of killing a woman in a Naha hotel and robbing her.

top.title: Saudi-backed Yemen government launches offensive on Houthis
top.description: President Rashad al-Alimi vowed to retake all rebel-held territory after the Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi Aramco site in Riyadh.

top.title: Trump weighs Iran decision: 'easy way or hard way'
top.description: Trump spoke Saturday as another carrier group and thousands more US troops head to the Middle East while talks with Tehran stall.

top.title: Nolo regains major hurricane status, set to become typhoon
top.description: Forecasters say the Category 3 storm will cross the International Date Line by midday Sunday Hawaii time, a rare hurricane-to-typhoon transition.

top.title: Kim oversees hypersonic missile test, claims 1,000-km range
top.description: North Korea's 1,000-km claim beats Seoul's estimate of more than 700 km, as tensions rise over a DMZ landmine blast that wounded South Korean soldiers.

top.title: Trump urges GOP to vote by mail after years of attacks
top.description: In a Truth Social video, he urged early and mail voting weeks after the Supreme Court struck down his mail ballot restrictions.

top.title: Federal judge rules Flock plate search unconstitutional
top.description: The Oklahoma ruling tossed meth evidence from a warrantless database search as Sanders and Ocasio-Cortez propose banning federal use of plate readers.

top.title: Hegseth signals troop shift from Europe to Latin America
top.description: The defense secretary linked a possible move to the war on drug cartels and to pressure on NATO allies to defend Europe.

top.title: Trump narrows $5,000 dividend pledge back to adults
top.description: A day after promising the payment to every citizen, Trump said adult citizens would get it if Republicans keep Congress Nov. 3.

top.title: Tennessee prisons chief to resign after failed execution
top.description: Commissioner Frank Strada's exit follows the botched lethal injection of Christa Pike, who remains unconscious on a ventilator, her attorneys say.

top.title: Two Iranian men charged over Manchester Yom Kippur plot
top.description: Police allege the pair held bomb-making components and scouted targets; charges came on the anniversary of the Heaton Park synagogue attack.

top.title: Trump says Iran has 'virtually given up' nuclear weapons
top.description: Trump offered no evidence as Iran keeps blocking U.N. nuclear inspections, with a lawmaker saying cooperation hinges on security guarantees.

top.title: Oman grounded FlyDubai co-pilot over radical views
top.description: Sources say FlyDubai later hired him to fly the UAE-Israel route, where he allegedly stabbed his captain and sent Flight 1073 diving.

top.title: Hegseth unveils new military command for drones and AI
top.description: The Autonomous Warfare Command, targeted for Oct. 1, 2027, would be the first new combatant command since 2019 and needs congressional approval.

top.title: Alito says he'll revisit retirement decision in 2027
top.description: The 76-year-old justice told CBS News he considered stepping down this year, raising the prospect of a fourth Trump Supreme Court nomination.

top.title: ShinyHunters says it won't release stolen FBI data
top.description: The hacking group called its earlier leak threats "a marketing campaign," days after Dutch police announced the arrest of an alleged leader.

top.title: Hochul vows to close intoxication loophole in NY rape law
top.description: The pledge follows outcry after prosecutors declined charges in an alleged Cornell gang rape; Hochul plans legislation early next year.

top.title: Vance led secret Camp David talks on Iran war, Houthis
top.description: Trump's top security aides met for hours Friday as Iran talks stall and Trump weighs resuming major combat operations, Axios reports.

top.title: Job growth slows to 29,000 as unemployment rises to 4.2%
top.description: The September total fell far short of economists' forecasts of about 90,000 jobs. The Fed holds its next rate meeting Oct. 27-28.

top.title: Putin vows to take rest of Donetsk sooner than expected
top.description: At the Valdai forum, Putin claimed Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers in September, but AFP analysis of ISW data shows Ukraine gained ground.

top.title: Trump rules out diesel export ban after G7 fuel release
top.description: G7 leaders agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel over four months, frontloading diesel as U.S. prices near records.

top.title: Germany pledges help as Burnham floats rejoining EU
top.description: Ambassador Susanne Baumann's pledge follows Macron's "welcome back," while Brussels awaits concrete proposals and Farage vows to fight.

top.title: Carney names Pacific oil pipeline first national interest project
top.description: The million-barrel-a-day oil pipeline to Delta, B.C., moves to a faster federal review, with Ottawa aiming to finalize conditions by Sept. 1, 2027.

top.title: Justice Department won't reopen ex-Fed chair Powell probe
top.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche's decision follows a watchdog report clearing Powell over Fed renovation costs; Trump still wants him off the board.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine used own ballistic missile in combat
top.description: Zelensky didn't disclose the target of the Fire Point-made FP-7, a hard-to-intercept weapon, and said scaling up production comes next.

top.title: Senate adjourns until after midterms as GOP fears losses
top.description: Before leaving Wednesday, senators confirmed Keith Sonderling as labor secretary, while Democrats blocked last-minute Republican bills on data centers and stock trading.

top.title: Judge rules noncitizen voting law unconstitutional
top.description: The Miami ruling dismissed charges against a Jamaican national, dealing a blow to the Trump administration's noncitizen voting crackdown before the midterms.

top.title: CNN finds Kushner firm is top investor in Israeli arms supplier
top.description: Affinity Partners holds the largest stake in Phoenix Financial, which invested in Elbit and other military suppliers while Kushner negotiated on Gaza.

top.title: Iran denies offering inspector access for sanctions relief
top.description: Bloomberg reported Foreign Minister Araghchi privately floated restoring inspectors' access to bombed sites, but IRNA called the report "absolutely false."

top.title: Trump asked Grok about Maduro capture, Time reports
top.description: An official told Time that Trump asked Musk's chatbot in December 2025 how Venezuelans would react, weeks before the January raid.

top.title: Putin rejects strike truce, says Russia lost 1% of GDP
top.description: Putin called a U.S.-backed proposal to mutually halt refinery and ship attacks "ridiculous" and said Kyiv's strikes had partly succeeded.

top.title: DOJ reviews whether Watergate prosecutors mistreated Nixon
top.description: Former Nixon White House lawyer Geoff Shepard helped prompt the review, The Wall Street Journal reports, citing people familiar with the matter.

top.title: US sends third carrier, up to 10,000 troops to Middle East
top.description: The buildup, due by late November, comes as Trump weighs resuming strikes on Iran after the midterms, officials told the Journal.

top.title: Anthropic targets IPO before Thanksgiving, Bloomberg says
top.description: The Claude maker could start formal marketing as soon as the week of Nov. 9 after pushing back earlier listing plans.

top.title: Judge tosses Hearn Reflecting Pool case with prejudice
top.description: Judge Todd Edelman's ruling bars the Justice Department from refiling charges after prosecutors found a botched installation, not vandalism, damaged the pool.

top.title: Trump calls low polls 'fake numbers' in TIME interview
top.description: A new AP-NORC poll released the same day put his approval at 31%, as voters sour over prices ahead of November midterms.

top.title: Rubio ordered Iran's UN team out, U.S. official says
top.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's delegation flew to Doha early Tuesday after U.S.-Iran talks stalled, a rare diplomatic rebuke.

top.title: Gov. Lee orders review after Pike survives lethal injection
top.description: Christa Pike was still alive after two doses of pentobarbital Wednesday. A death penalty expert called it unprecedented. She was taken to a hospital.

top.title: Trump refuses to rule out demolishing Kennedy Center
top.description: Trump told Time "I'm not committing to anything" as courts weigh whether his name can go on the shuttered performing arts center.

top.title: OpenAI's Brockman drops second $25M gift to AI super PAC
top.description: Brockman told OpenAI staff in June that the Leading the Future super PAC had become a "distraction," according to The New York Times.

top.title: Hegseth calls media coverage of Iran war 'treason'
top.description: The defense secretary accused journalists of endangering troops during his annual address at Marine Corps Base Quantico, escalating his campaign against the press.

top.title: Trump says he'd consider pardoning his own officials
top.description: In a TIME interview published Thursday, Trump cited Biden's preemptive pardons, weeks before midterms where Democrats vow to investigate his administration.

top.title: Huang, other CEOs confronted Amodei over AI warnings at White House
top.description: Behind the scenes of Tuesday's voluntary AI safety accord, tech executives challenged Anthropic's chief over his calls to slow development.

top.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon to reclaim AI frontier
top.description: The new flagship model claims to outperform OpenAI and Anthropic rivals on coding and cybersecurity benchmarks after months of delays.

top.title: South Korea disputes Trump's $54B Alaska LNG claim
top.description: Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan says he told Commerce Secretary Lutnick the announcement overstated the deal, insisting participation hinges on commercial viability.

top.title: Senate fails to advance data center cost bill as GOP fractures widen
top.description: The Ratepayer Protection Act fell short of the 60 votes needed to overcome a filibuster, deepening a rift over AI infrastructure ahead of the midterms.

top.title: Senate Dems block bill to ban lawmakers from trading stocks
top.description: Democrats united to kill the Stop Insider Trading Act, calling it too weak and citing an unrelated voter ID "poison pill" provision.

top.title: Renee Good's family sues Trump officials over ICE shooting
top.description: Two suits filed in Minnesota federal court allege wrongful death and a civil rights conspiracy by agent Jonathan Ross and senior officials.

top.title: Russia calls European arms factories for Ukraine legitimate military targets
top.description: Moscow's foreign ministry spokeswoman said factories producing weapons for Kyiv "will not be safe," escalating threats against NATO members.

top.title: Anthropic warns Z.ai's GLM-5.3 AI can build cyber exploits without safeguards
top.description: The company says the open-weight model from Zhipu AI matches its own Claude Mythos Preview in exploit capability but lacks meaningful protections against misuse.

top.title: Supreme Court takes up Trump's immigrant detention policy
top.description: Justices will decide whether longtime U.S. residents facing deportation are entitled to bond hearings, after most appeals courts rejected the administration's interpretation.

top.title: Ken Griffin gives record $3B to Carnegie Mellon for new Miami campus
top.description: The Citadel founder's gift is the largest individual donation in higher education history, funding a 35-acre campus in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood.

top.title: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq after two decades
top.description: The final American forces depart Wednesday, ending Operation Inherent Resolve and over 20 years of military involvement in the country.

top.title: GOP senator blocks bid to stop Trump's $810M cancellation
top.description: Sen. Ron Johnson objected to a Democratic bill, letting the administration's "pocket rescission" run out the clock as the fiscal year ends.

top.title: Judge orders NYC to scrap 17,000 pied-à-terre tax notices
top.description: A Staten Island judge ruled the Mamdani administration violated homeowners' due process rights and must redo the rollout of its luxury second-home surcharge.

top.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026
top.description: Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and can connect to over 4,000 apps to handle tasks around the clock.

top.title: Hegseth taps Musk, Luckey, Gingrich to lead Pentagon future warfare study
top.description: Project Meridian gives the trio 120 days to identify weapons and technologies the U.S. military will need for conflicts decades from now.

top.title: GOP senator's perjury claim against Jack Smith collapses over basketball team mix-up
top.description: Sen. Eric Schmitt accused the former special counsel of lying about attending an Atlanta Hawks game, but the game was actually an Iowa Hawkeyes match in Maryland.

top.title: Myanmar airstrike on crowded Rakhine market kills at least 50
top.description: Rescuers found more bodies Tuesday after a military jet bombed a wholesale market and bridge in Kyauktaw, wounding 58 others.

top.title: Paxton privately said Trump convention hurt GOP numbers, leaked audio reveals
top.description: The Texas Senate candidate told donors "everybody's numbers dropped" after the Dallas event, even as Trump claimed it helped.

top.title: NATO denounces Russia's nuclear threat over Kaliningrad
top.description: Moscow warned it would use "the entire arsenal" including nuclear weapons to defend the Baltic exclave from any NATO isolation attempt.

top.title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra over deception, safety failures
top.description: The next-gen model, due in October for ChatGPT and Codex, showed deceptive behavior and acted without user permission during internal testing.
